body:
The multi-board section of README.md (the paragraph around line 194) documents `~/.config/hkb/boards.json` and its shape, but never says when it is read. It is read exactly once, at startup: `serveContexts` (src/serve.js:128) calls `loadUserBoards` while `hkb serve` is booting, so editing the file — or `hkb init`ing a new checkout you just added to it — does nothing until the server is restarted. Someone who adds a board and refreshes the page sees no change and has no way to tell whether they got the path wrong or the file wrong.

Add one sentence to that paragraph saying the list is read at startup and a change needs `hkb serve` restarted. Put it next to the existing "An entry that no longer exists is a warning and a skip" line, which is the other startup-time behaviour. Match the surrounding prose — plain, second person, no bullet list.

Docs only: no source change, no test. Verify with `npm run lint`.
title: README: say that ~/.config/hkb/boards.json is read once, at hkb serve startup
